note: Set status to "agreed", list who agreed and the date BEFORE running tools/freeze.py. Rules may not change after freezing.
pipeline: board2notes-ocr package 2026-11-09, unchanged (MANIFEST.json SHA-256 recorded at freeze)

excluded_writer_groups: any Board2Notes teammate (the 64 uncertain-writer teammate crops make every teammate a possible training writer)
the writer(s) of the lecture / CNN / whiteboard training photos
the writer(s) of the familiar-writer long-sentence collection

normalisation: lower-case; every run of whitespace (spaces, line breaks) becomes one space; leading/trailing space removed; punctuation, digits and accents kept; no spelling correction (identical to notebook 15 norm())

reference.unit: one line of the transcription file = one written line on the board, in the reviewers' human reading order
reference.write_what_is_written: keep the writer's own misspellings, capitalisation and punctuation
reference.non_handwriting: omit printed labels, screens, posters and the board frame; they are not reference text
reference.illegible_line: a line both reviewers cannot read is written as [illegible]; it is removed from the reference. Whatever the app reads there still counts in the main metric (the student sees it); with quads, regions on it are reported as illegible_region, not as extra
reference.uncertain_characters: reviewers agree one best reading and note the doubt in the manifest notes column; the agreed reading is the reference

main_metric.name: pooled page CER in the app's own reading order
main_metric.definition: sum over photos of Levenshtein(norm(reference page), norm(app lines joined by spaces)) / sum over photos of len(norm(reference page))
main_metric.why: what a student actually receives; identical to notebook 15's main metric
main_metric.includes: recognition errors, missed/extra/merged/split regions AND reading-order errors

photo_bootstrap_interval.caveat: resamples photos with the 2-3 writers fixed; it does not represent uncertainty over new writers

requires_quads.reading_order_free_page_CER: page CER with predicted components re-ordered by the reference reading order (notebook 15 'GT-reordered'); main minus this = the cost of reading order, which is deferred work and reported separately
requires_quads.region_diagnostics: one-to-one, missed, extra, merge, split and many-to-many counts from the notebook 15 overlap rule
requires_quads.matched_line_CER: CER over one-to-one components only (recognition on correctly found single lines)

decision_rule.note: Recommended: report descriptively. The development figure (0.87% mean LINE CER on 59 matched JH lines) is a different metric on a different unit and must not be used as a pass mark. If the team wants a threshold, set type to "threshold" and threshold_page_CER (e.g. 0.05) here before freezing.

no_tuning: No setting, model, crop, threshold or rule is changed in response to these photos. Any change afterwards needs a new, separate set of fresh photos to confirm it.
single_run: Predictions are produced once, after freezing. Re-running is refused; a failure of the run itself (crash) is logged, fixed in tooling only, and the run is restarted from scratch with the same frozen inputs.
